$comment: WO-14 alias layer — every retired roster name resolves declaratively to its new (role, rung) pair per final-plan.md §6.6, alongside the legacy identity it carries while the legacy roster is installed. The kill switch is the roster flag: 'legacy' resolves a name to the installed legacy agent unchanged; 'new' resolves it through the WO-6 casting tables. Evaluated PER ORDER (router.resolveSeat opts.roster overrides rosterDefault); rollback is a flag flip, no file changes. Every resolution of a retired name emits a ledger deprecation line. Class alias I1 → I0 lives in registry/classes.json, not here.
